topic: Introduction to surveillance system Surveillance systems of the aircrafts.
syllabus_extract: Introduction to surveillance system Surveillance systems of the aircrafts.
specific_objectives: 18.1.3.1 Trainee will be able to describe the basic theory of operation of surveillance system of an aircraft.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Review of IB diagrams regarding surveillance loops; Instructor supervision required for diagram interpretation.
intro_questions: What is the primary purpose of an aircraft surveillance system?
List three types of aircraft surveillance systems.
Why is surveillance critical for air traffic control?

development.content:
Definition of aircraft surveillance
Importance of surveillance in aviation
Basic components of surveillance
Types of surveillance systems
General theory of operation

Active vs passive surveillance
Radar-based detection principles
Signal transmission and reception
Data processing and display
System integration with avionics

Surveillance system limitations
Common failure modes
Maintenance considerations
Safety implications of failure
Future trends in surveillance

summary_questions: Explain the basic theory of operation for a standard aircraft surveillance system.
Differentiate between active and passive surveillance methods.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on how the principles of surveillance discussed in this lesson apply to the SSR/transponder system covered in LP 02.

pft_rows.syllabus: Introduction to SSR/transponder System. Interrogators responders. Main technological characteristics of the System.
